items.title: Vim Exit
items.text: Vim-style exit aliases for the shell. Also tunes readline timing for vi-mode key sequences.

items.title: Changelog
items.text: All notable changes to this project will be documented in this file. See commit-and-tag-version for commit guidelines.

items.title: Features
items.text:
• add ability to exit insert mode using jj in the terminal (b0c0d46)
  • alias: add :q alias for exit (e582374)
  • alias: add :wq alias for exit (942d9e7)
